kanjidic2.transform: Japanese ja_on/ja_kun readings, excluding nanori; primary stroke count; school grade when present; classical radical number. Old four-level JLPT values are not reused as modern levels. Per-card metadata is retained in n2-batch-sources/batch-NN.json.

jmdict.transform: Japanese spelling/reading pairs honor re_restr and re_nokanji; selected senses honor stagk and stagr. Inherited part-of-speech labels are retained. Separate spellingPriority and readingPriority retain their source flags; priority is their union for candidate navigation, not a frequency claim about the spelling.
jmdict.limits: Spelling/reading and applicable-sense evidence does not establish frequency, example-sentence naturalness, or JLPT vocabulary membership.

radicalGlyphs.transform: Classical radical n uses the compatibility decomposition of U+2F00+n-1.

strokes.transform: Existing tools/generate_strokes.py converter: original stroke order, 16 arc-length-resampled points per stroke in the source 109 by 109 coordinate space. No stroke paths are authored by hand.

limits: Dictionary URLs are refreshed upstream; hashes identify the inspected downloads. Source-only readings remain explicitly qualified. These records do not establish etymology, phonetic components, semantic interchangeability, or naturalness of every example. Existing word identities and sourced vocabulary labels are reused without deriving vocabulary levels from kanji levels.
